storage_class.comment: Same access profile, no minimum duration on either side.
Both feature 30-day minimum storage duration and immediate millisecond access for infrequently accessed data.
GCP Nearline provides multi-AZ or multi-region redundancy, covering more resilience than AWS single-AZ One Zone-IA.
Coldline's 90-day minimum matches Glacier Instant Retrieval's 90-day minimum; both provide millisecond latency, but retrieval rate structures differ.
Coldline's 90-day minimum matches Glacier Flexible's 90-day minimum; Archive's 365-day minimum does not. Retrieval pricing differs and is NOT covered by this claim.
Explicitly not equivalent. Asserting this prevents the 120x over-projection seen historically.
Archive's 365-day minimum matches Glacier Deep Archive's 180-day profile most closely. Retrieval latency profile differs (minutes vs hours).
GCP Autoclass automatically transitions objects without an additional monitoring charge; standard is the baseline tier.
